# Version 4.150.0
> **First m150 stable release** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 is the stable Skia m150 release with new filtering and diagnostics APIs. It adds image-filter and overdraw helpers, improves surface canvas access, and promotes remaining v3 obsolete APIs to compile errors.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remaining v3 obsolete APIs removed** — APIs previously marked obsolete before v4 are now compile errors. Replace obsolete members with their recommended v4 alternatives before upgrading. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 150 and includes subsequent upstream maintenance fixes. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **New image-filter and overdraw helpers** — Adds crop and empty image filters plus an overdraw color filter for rendering diagnostics. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229))
- **Fast bounds calculation available** — Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds for efficient culling decisions. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-sigma raster blur regression fixed** — Avoids the slow raster blur path that caused incorrect results for small blur sigmas. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Surface canvas wrapper reused** — SKSurface now caches its Canvas wrapper, reducing repeated wrapper allocation during drawing. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.1 for text shaping consumers.
